The league competition consisted of 16 teams. The competition is being conducted during the [[Russo-Ukrainian war (2022–present)|ongoing war with Russia since late February 2022]].{{cite web |title=Додаткові заходи безпеки для організації та проведення футбольних матчів в Україні в умовах воєнного стану |url=https://uaf.ua/storage/documents/01KY22TTNR3MYA6PVDQ6JTT91Q.pdf |website=uaf.ua |access-date=27 July 2026 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20260727185437/https://uaf.ua/storage/documents/01KY22TTNR3MYA6PVDQ6JTT91Q.pdf |archive-date=27 July 2026 |language=Ukrainian |trans-title=Extra security measures for organizations and carrying out football games in Ukraine under the martial law conditions}} It was announced that the new season would start around 25 July 2026 as "base" date,{{cite web |title=Перша ліга визначилась з датою старту нового чемпіонату |url=https://sport.ua/uk/news/879368-persha-liga-viznachilas-z-datoyu-startu-novogo-chempionatu |website=sport.ua |access-date=17 June 2026}} later it was confirmed that some matchweek 1 games take place on 24 and others 26. == Teams == As in the preceding season, this season of the Ukrainian First League consisted of 16 teams.{{cite web |title=Визначилися всі учасники Першої ліги у сезоні 2026/27 |url=https://www.ua-football.com/ua/ukrainian/first/1781016348-viznachilisya-vsi-uchasniki-pershoyi-ligi-u-sezoni-2026-27.html |website=www.ua-football.com |access-date=17 June 2026}}{{cite web |title=ОФІЦІЙНО.
